**Skill this week:** mapping inequality and access. By the end of the week you should be able to explain what the HDI and Gini coefficient measure, make a bivariate map, build a simple composite index, and model travel time to health care.

## Map

Complete ArcGIS Online Exercises 9.1 The human development report, 9.3 Density: the rural–urban divide in the United States, and 9.4 Distance: how does proximity to urban areas impact development? The links are at [esri.com/Human-Geography](https://www.esri.com/Human-Geography).

For more practice: Exercises 9.2 The invisible hand, and 9.5 Globalization or protectionism.

## Public health case

A GIS travel-time model for about 23,000 homesteads found a median of 81 minutes to the nearest clinic. Homesteads within 30 minutes had about ten times the odds of using a clinic as those 90 to 120 minutes away.
